title: 第九章 趣味
content_zh:
所有的房间都是一种样式，床，桌子、椅子，还有柜子，就跟外面人类的旅店一样，简单。

    萨尔无聊的往床上一躺，习惯了的棺材变成了床，多少有些不适，不过现在身处这种地方，说起来也是别人的地盘，也就没有什么可挑剔了，只是……

    想着那“未婚夫”三个字，他的心就怎么也舒展不了，毕竟这个是他渴望了许多年的头衔，现在突然戴到了别人的头上，他怎么可能甘心。

    可是如果艾妮尔愿意，他又能做些什么呢？这么多年以来，难道说不是她说一就是一，她说做朋友就做朋友，她说是亲人就是亲人，没有血源关系，也没有男女关系。

    这样的相处，这样的生活，对外人来说，只是奇怪，对他来说更多的是折磨，特别是当他想要告诉她一切，包括自己的心与秘密时，她所给他的只是一个背影，一个冰冷的回绝，虽然委婉，但也足够刺伤他那充满渴望等待以久的心。

    不过，也许可以从头再来。

    静静的躺着，听着已经许久不再跳动的心在那里发出渴望之声，萨尔的嘴角微微的弯起，闭上双眼，进入平静的休息。

    正当他将要入眠时，突然感觉到门开了，然后门又关了，一串轻微的脚步声临近，他随意的问，“不知道爱夏小姐找我有什么事？”

    “你说呢？”说着，对方已经倚着他的身边坐下，最后侧身躺下，手不规矩的抚上了他的脸颊，“一个女人主动找上一个男人，还是在休息的时间。”

    “如果小姐是想找我取乐，那么不好意思，我现在没这个心情。”萨尔睁开眼睛，直视着对方，眼中没有一点迷离之色。

    “那你什么时候会有这个心情呢？”面对如此无情干脆的拒绝，爱夏不但不生气，还一脸笑意的寻问道。

    “这个我暂时也不知道，也许明天会有，也许永远也不会有。”萨尔说着，让开爱夏的身子，起床坐到了桌前。

    “那如果我是来让先生你取乐的呢？”结果对方毫不犹豫的换了种方式，干脆脱了外衣，舒展着身子躺到了床上，侧身望着萨尔。

    “结果有所不同吗？”萨尔笑了笑，对于这个陌生到只知道她叫爱夏的女人，他并没有太多的好感，加上现在身处敌阵之中，他至少得多一丝戒备吧！

    “当然不同，如果像先生你说的那样，那么就是你服务于我，让我快乐，而像我说的这个样子，就是我服务于你，那自然是让你快乐。”对方一边说着，一边还不忘了向着萨尔摆出各种暧昧的姿态。

    “如果我说，无论你怎么做都不能让我快乐呢？”萨尔心中自然明白自己所爱所想的是谁，虽然面前的她在相貌上绝不输于对方，可是爱这种东西，完全不是可以从理论来分析并断定的，不然他也不会如此的痛苦。

    “那谁能让先生快乐？那个叫艾妮尔的女孩子？”说着，爱夏从床上坐了起来，摆弄着自己耳侧的卷发，“不过……她是不是小了点？而且似乎她并不太可能来让先生你取乐啊！”

    “那又怎么样？”这点萨尔比谁都清楚，相遇相处了那么长的时间，他除了不明白艾尼尔心里在想些什么之外，完全明白她的决定，因为她已经表现的足够清楚明白。

    “当然是……”说着，爱夏从背后抱住了萨尔，暧昧之极，“由我来代替她让先生你快乐好了。”

    “不好意思，现在我即没兴趣，也没性趣。”萨尔伸手掰开缠在腰上的双手，转身向前面的那个房间走去。

    “你想去找她？”身后之人有些意外。

    “不！”萨尔没有回头，毕竟他不想看到另一个自己。
content_en:
All the rooms have the same style, with beds, tables, chairs, and cabinets, just like human hotels outside, simple.

    Sal lay down on the bed out of boredom. The coffin he was used to became a bed, which made him feel a little uncomfortable. But now that he was in a place like this, it was also someone else's territory, so there was nothing to criticize. It was just...

    Thinking about the three words "fiancé", his heart couldn't relax. After all, this was the title he had longed for for many years. Now that it was suddenly placed on someone else's head, how could he be willing to accept it.

    But if Enel is willing, what can he do? For so many years, couldn't it be said that what she said was one, what she said was a friend was what she said was a friend, what she said was a relative was a relative, there was no blood relationship, and there was no male-female relationship.

    This kind of relationship, this kind of life, is just strange to outsiders, but more like torture to him, especially when he wants to tell her everything, including his heart and secrets, all she gives him is a back view and a cold rejection, although it is tactful, it is enough to hurt his heart that has been full of longing and waiting for a long time.

    But maybe you can start over.

    Lying quietly, listening to the longing voice of his heart that had stopped beating for a long time, Sal's mouth slightly curved, he closed his eyes and entered a peaceful rest.

    Just when he was about to fall asleep, he suddenly felt the door open and then close again. A series of slight footsteps approached. He asked casually, "I wonder what Miss Ai Xia wants to see me for?"

    "What do you think?" As he said this, the other person had already sat down beside him, and finally lay down on his side, with his hand caressing his cheek irregularly. "A woman takes the initiative to find a man, and it's still during her rest time."

    "If the lady wants to have fun with me, then I'm sorry, I'm not in the mood right now." Sal opened his eyes and looked directly at the other person, with no trace of confusion in his eyes.

    "Then when will you feel like this?" Faced with such a ruthless and straightforward rejection, Ai Xia not only did not get angry, but also asked with a smile on her face.

    "I don't know about this yet. Maybe it will happen tomorrow, maybe it will never happen." Sal said, getting out of Aisha's body, getting up and sitting at the table.

    "What if I'm here to entertain you, sir?" As a result, the other party changed his approach without hesitation, simply took off his coat, stretched himself out on the bed, and looked sideways at Sal.

    "Is the result different?" Sal smiled. He didn't have much affection for this strange woman who only knew her as Aisha. Plus, he was now in the enemy's camp, so he should at least be more vigilant!

    "Of course it's different. If it's like what you said, sir, then you serve me and make me happy. But like what I said, if I serve you, then of course it will make you happy." As the other party spoke, he did not forget to make various ambiguous gestures towards Sal.

    "What if I say, no matter what you do, you can't make me happy?" Sal naturally knew in his heart who he loved and thought about. Although she was by no means inferior to her in appearance, love was something that could not be analyzed and determined theoretically, otherwise he would not be in such pain.

    "Then who can make Sir happy? That girl named Enel?" As she said this, Ai Xia sat up from the bed and fiddled with the curly hair beside her ears, "But... is she a little small? And it seems unlikely that she will come to make you happy, Sir!"

    "So what?" Sal knew this better than anyone else. They had met and been together for such a long time. Apart from not understanding what Enil was thinking, he fully understood her decision because she had made it clear enough.

    "Of course..." As she said that, Aisha hugged Sal from behind, extremely ambiguous, "Let me take her place and make you happy, sir."

    "I'm sorry, I'm neither interested nor sexually interested right now." Sal stretched out his hands and unwrapped his hands around his waist, turned around and walked towards the room in front of him.

    "You want to find her?" The person behind him was a little surprised.

    "No!" Sal didn't look back, after all, he didn't want to see another version of himself.
